form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Ms. Cortez Masto (for herself, Ms. Smith, Mr. Durbin, Mr. Brown, Ms. Cantwell, Mr. Menendez, Ms. Warren, Ms. Klobuchar, Mr. Blumenthal, and Mrs. Feinstein) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs

form.official-title: To amend the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act of 1975 to modify the exemptions from certain disclosure requirements.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Home Loan Quality Transparency Act of 2021.

subsection.text: Section 304 of the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act of 1975 (12 U.S.C. 2803) is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking subsection (i) and inserting the following:

subsection.text: The requirements of paragraphs (4), (5), and (6) of subsection (b) shall not apply with respect to any depository institution described in section 303(3)(A) that has total assets, as of the most recent full fiscal year of the institution, of $30,000,000 or less.
Section 104 of the Economic Growth, Regulatory Relief, and Consumer Protection Act (Public Law 115–174) is amended by striking subsection (b).
